scene: The smiling skater halts, presenting a pair of humming neon skates.
picture: A flat side view along a polished wooden roller rink. On the far left sits a glowing tea gazebo with an open door. The player in lilac headscarf, mustard coat, and brown satchel stands centre-left, facing the grinning gardener at centre who holds out glowing neon skates, his clippers rattling on his right hip.
shown: glowing neon roller skates held out in the gardener's hands at centre
a bulging leather belt hung with brass clippers on the gardener at right
an ornate wooden gazebo with an open doorway on the far left
